To the right, a silver metal panel is propped up, with a chaotic pile of hand tools (pliers, screwdrivers, wrenches) scattered on the floor beneath it. A green plastic tray and an orange bucket are also visible. The background contains cardboard boxes, a trash can, and part of a scooter.
